what: V1: BWB reference wing 0, VC, Re 3e5, the C-H volume mesh on the Stage 2 surface

checks.name: wall_on_surface
checks.limit: <= 1e-12 c: every wall node is the Stage 2 node (wing, base, cap)

checks.name: no_folded_cell
checks.limit: 0 cells with a corner Jacobian <= 0 (every corner of every cell)

checks.name: cell_quality
checks.limit: >= 0.05 (smallest corner scaled Jacobian of every cell but the cap's two nose-corner columns, reported on their own: decision 101)
checks.note: the cap's two nose-corner columns 0.0621; every cell 0.0621

checks.name: wall_orthogonality
checks.limit: <= 5.0 deg in the station plane at every wall node but the two trailing-edge corners
checks.note: station 60; corners up to 3.66 deg; 3-D angle median 2.55, max 27.5 deg

checks.name: first_cell
checks.limit: <= 1% off the asked first cell: s0 (law 13) on every wing line, the wing's last chordwise cell on every base line

checks.name: growth
checks.limit: growth / limit <= 1.01 on every line: 1.25 inside the fine zone (2 local c), 1.3 beyond

checks.name: bl_cells
checks.limit: >= 17.75 cells across delta (turbulent flat plate at x = 1 local c, from the local Re; decision 86)

checks.name: interfaces
checks.limit: <= 1e-10 c node to node; no open face

checks.name: far_field
checks.limit: >= 80 c from every wall node (round-off 1e-09 c)

checks.name: wake
checks.limit: streamwise growth / limit <= 1.01; cells inside the band <= the band cell x 1.01

checks.name: outboard
checks.limit: first gap = the tip gap within 1%; growth <= 1.3 out to 2 c past the tip, <= 1.3 beyond (x 1.01)
checks.note: first gap / tip gap 1.000000, growth / limit 0.9893

checks.name: cells_ram
checks.note: 2.324 M cells, 23.5 GiB; desktop 16 GB: False, +36 GB: True
